description: Wire the three resolver consumers: rewire POST /api/numbers/embedded-signup OAuth exchange to resolveMetaAppCredentials; rewire POST /api/webhooks/whatsapp to per-app signature verification via a bounded candidate-secret set (fail-closed); add the session-scoped GET/PUT/DELETE /api/meta-app CRUD route. Depends on FEAT-001 (resolver + schema + migrated table). Grounded in the actual current embedded-signup, webhook, and manual route files.
steps: Rewire src/app/api/numbers/embedded-signup/route.ts per design §3: remove the direct process.env.META_APP_ID/META_APP_SECRET reads and the inline missing-env 500; import { resolveMetaAppCredentials, MetaAppConfigError } from '@/lib/meta-app'; after the session guard and body parse do `let appId: string, appSecret: string; try { ({ appId, appSecret } = await resolveMetaAppCredentials(session.user.id)); } catch (e) { if (e instanceof MetaAppConfigError) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Server is not configured for Embedded Signup' }, { status: 500 }); throw e; }`. Keep the exact 500 copy. Leave every downstream Graph call, encrypt, upsertNumberForUser, serializeNumber, and the 201/400/409/401/500 branches unchanged.

Rewire src/app/api/webhooks/whatsapp/route.ts POST per design §4 in the EXACT load-bearing order. (1) const raw = await request.text() (unchanged, read once). (2) Signature-header gate FIRST: require x-hub-signature-256 starting with 'sha256=', else console.warn + 401 with NO JSON.parse and NO prisma query; remove today's unconditional META_APP_SECRET-missing 401 that currently precedes the header check; keep theirHex = header.slice('sha256='.length) and a = Buffer.from(theirHex,'hex').

Webhook step 3: parse raw in try/catch ONLY to collect candidate phone_number_ids into a Set, capped at MAX_CANDIDATE_PHONE_IDS = 10 (iterate body.entry[].changes[].value.metadata.phone_number_id; break when the Set reaches 10); unparseable -> []. This parsed value is untrusted and used only to select candidate secrets.

Webhook step 4: build secrets: Set<string> = process.env.META_APP_SECRET (if set) plus, for the capped ids, prisma.whatsAppNumber.findMany({ where: { phoneNumberId: { in } }, select: { userId: true } }) -> distinct userIds -> prisma.tenantMetaApp.findMany({ where: { userId: { in } }, select: { metaAppSecret: true } }) -> decrypt(app.metaAppSecret) inside try/catch, skipping any candidate whose decrypt throws (no log, no crash). Import decrypt from '@/lib/crypto'. Do NOT call resolveMetaAppCredentials here (keep skip-bad-candidate semantics).

Webhook step 5: if secrets.size === 0 -> 401 (relocated 'no usable secret'). Step 6: for each secret compute crypto.createHmac('sha256', secret).update(raw,'utf8').digest('hex'); b = Buffer.from(ourHex,'hex'); if a.length === b.length && crypto.timingSafeEqual(a,b) set verified=true and break; if none match -> console.warn('[Webhook] Signature verification failed') + 401. Step 7: on verified, fall through to the UNCHANGED const body = JSON.parse(raw) processing loop (statuses, inbound messages, strict phone_number_id -> WhatsAppNumber routing, conversation upsert, always return 200). Leave the GET handshake unchanged. Never log any secret/ciphertext on any branch.

Create src/app/api/meta-app/route.ts per design §5 with GET/PUT/DELETE. Imports: getServerSession + authOptions from '@/lib/auth', prisma from '@/lib/db', encrypt from '@/lib/crypto', z from 'zod', NextResponse. Add internal serializeMetaApp(row: TenantMetaApp | null) returning { appId, configId, source, hasSecret } from row presence (never selects/returns the ciphertext; hasSecret means 'stored', not 'valid'; does NOT decrypt): row -> { appId: row.metaAppId, configId: row.configId ?? null, source: 'tenant', hasSecret: true }; null -> { appId: process.env.META_APP_ID ?? null, configId: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_META_CONFIG_ID ?? null, source: 'platform', hasSecret: false }.
meta-app GET: 401 if no session; const row = await prisma.tenantMetaApp.findUnique({ where: { userId: session.user.id } }); return serializeMetaApp(row).

meta-app PUT: 401 if no session; zod putSchema = z.object({ metaAppId: z.string().trim().min(1).max(100), metaAppSecret: z.string().min(10).max(500).optional(), configId: z.string().trim().min(1).max(100).nullish() }); on parse failure 400 { error: 'Invalid request body', details: parsed.error.flatten() }. Cheap existence check findUnique({ where:{userId}, select:{id:true} }); if !existing && !metaAppSecret -> 400 { error: 'App secret is required to connect your Meta app' }. Build update payload: { metaAppId }; if metaAppSecret add metaAppSecret: encrypt(metaAppSecret); if configId !== undefined add configId (null clears, string sets). Call prisma.tenantMetaApp.upsert({ where:{userId}, create:{ userId, metaAppId, metaAppSecret: encrypt(metaAppSecret!), configId: configId ?? null }, update: updateData }); return serializeMetaApp(row) with 200.

meta-app DELETE: 401 if no session; await prisma.tenantMetaApp.deleteMany({ where: { userId: session.user.id } }); return { ok: true } 200 (idempotent). Wrap all three methods' bodies in try/catch -> 500 { error: 'Internal server error' } without logging the secret.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/numbers/embedded-signup performs the OAuth code exchange with the tenant's appId/appSecret when a TenantMetaApp row exists and with platform env when it does not; a resolver MetaAppConfigError yields the same 500 'Server is not configured for Embedded Signup' as before; all other branches (201/400/409/401/500, serializeNumber, upsertNumberForUser, NumberOwnedByOtherTenantError) are unchanged.

POST /api/webhooks/whatsapp reads the raw body once, 401s with zero DB work on a missing/malformed signature header, builds a bounded (<=10 id) candidate-secret set (platform secret + owning tenants' decrypted secrets), accepts iff some candidate yields a timingSafeEqual match, 401s when no candidate matches or secrets.size===0, skips undecryptable candidates silently, and otherwise runs the existing processing loop returning 200; no secret/ciphertext is logged. The GET handshake is unchanged.

GET /api/meta-app returns { appId, configId, source, hasSecret } and never the secret value; PUT upserts atomically (encrypting the secret, leaving an existing secret unchanged when omitted, requiring a secret on create, clearing configId on null and leaving it on omit) with zod 400 on invalid body; DELETE clears the row idempotently; all three 401 without a session and scope strictly to session.user.id.
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm it completes with no type errors across the two modified routes and the new route.
Reason through design §3 (embedded-signup tenant vs platform branch + MetaAppConfigError -> same 500).

Reason through design §4 safety + error table: missing/malformed header -> 401 zero DB; IN bounded <=10; platform-secret body verifies when META_APP_SECRET set; tenant-secret body verifies even when platform secret unset (intended FR-4/AC-5 change); wrong-secret and secrets.size===0 -> 401; undecryptable candidate skipped; processing errors still 200.

Reason through design §5 error table + testability: no session -> 401 all methods; PUT create requires secret; PUT update omitting secret preserves it; configId null clears / omit leaves unchanged; GET never contains a secret field; concurrent PUT race-free via upsert; DELETE idempotent.
findings:
DONE. `npm run build` passes (exit 0, Compiled successfully); /api/meta-app registered as a dynamic route. The pre-existing 'Dynamic server usage' prerender messages are on unrelated routes (chat/messages/credits), not from these changes.

=== GET /api/meta-app response shape (what FEAT-003 UI consumes) ===
200 JSON: { appId: string | null, configId: string | null, source: 'tenant' | 'platform', hasSecret: boolean }.
- Tenant row present -> { appId: row.metaAppId, configId: row.configId ?? null, source: 'tenant', hasSecret: true }.
- No tenant row -> { appId: process.env.META_APP_ID ?? null, configId: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_META_CONFIG_ID ?? null, source: 'platform', hasSecret: false }.
- The secret VALUE is never returned. hasSecret means STORED, not VALID (serializeMetaApp never decrypts). So a tenant whose stored secret is undecryptable still shows source:'tenant', hasSecret:true. Per design §6 the Settings UI copy MUST be 'Secret is stored' (storage fact), NOT 'valid'/'connected'; remedy for a broken secret is to re-enter it (a fresh PUT overwrites the ciphertext).
- 401 { error: 'Unauthorized' } when no session.

=== PUT /api/meta-app contract ===
Body zod schema: { metaAppId: string trim 1..100 (required), metaAppSecret?: string 10..500 (optional, WRITE-ONLY), configId?: string trim 1..100 | null (nullish) }.
- Invalid body -> 400 { error: 'Invalid request body', details: <zod flatten()> }.
- Create with no stored row AND no metaAppSecret -> 400 { error: 'App secret is required to connect your Meta app' }.
- Secret rule: present -> encrypt+store; omitted on an existing row -> left UNCHANGED (not in update payload). UI: send metaAppSecret ONLY when the user typed one; secret input is type=password, never pre-filled.
- configId rule: omitted (undefined) -> left unchanged; null -> cleared to NULL; non-empty string -> set. UI: send string when set, send configId:null to intentionally clear a previously-set value, OMIT the key when not touching it. On CREATE, omitted configId stores null.
- Atomic via prisma.tenantMetaApp.upsert on userId @unique (no find-then-create P2002 race; the required-on-create existence check is a separate cheap findUnique guard, benign under all interleavings per design §5).
- Success -> 200 with the same serializeMetaApp shape as GET.
- 401 when no session; 500 { error: 'Internal server error' } on any throw (e.g. encrypt() when ENCRYPTION_KEY missing), secret never logged.

=== DELETE /api/meta-app contract ===
- 401 when no session.
- prisma.tenantMetaApp.deleteMany({ where: { userId } }) -> 200 { ok: true }. Idempotent (deleteMany does not throw when absent). Reverts tenant to platform fallback (Model A).

=== All methods ===
Session-guarded (getServerSession(authOptions)), strictly scoped to session.user.id (no client-supplied userId). Each method body wrapped in try/catch -> 500 { error: 'Internal server error' } with NO secret logged.

=== Embedded-signup rewire (§3) ===
Replaced the direct META_APP_ID/META_APP_SECRET env reads + inline 500 with resolveMetaAppCredentials(session.user.id); MetaAppConfigError -> same 500 'Server is not configured for Embedded Signup'; any other throw rethrown to the route's existing top-level catch -> generic 500. Downstream Graph calls / encrypt / upsertNumberForUser / serializeNumber / 201/400/409/401 branches and NumberOwnedByOtherTenantError UNCHANGED.

=== Webhook rewire (§4) ===
Exact step order: (1) raw read once; (2) x-hub-signature-256 'sha256=' header gate FIRST (missing/malformed -> warn + 401, ZERO parse/DB); removed the old unconditional META_APP_SECRET-missing 401; (3) peek-parse raw in try/catch to collect <=10 distinct phone_number_ids (MAX_CANDIDATE_PHONE_IDS=10), unparseable -> []; (4) secrets Set = platform META_APP_SECRET (if set) + decrypt of owning tenants' metaAppSecret (whatsAppNumber.findMany by phoneNumberId IN -> distinct userIds -> tenantMetaApp.findMany), undecryptable candidate skipped silently; (5) secrets.size===0 -> 401 (relocated 'no usable secret'); (6) per-candidate HMAC-SHA256 hex compared via length-guarded timingSafeEqual, accept iff one matches else warn + 401; (7) UNCHANGED processing loop (statuses, inbound, strict phone_number_id routing, conversation upsert, always 200). GET handshake unchanged. No secret/ciphertext logged on any branch. Intended behavior change (Model B tenant verifies against own secret even when platform secret unset) is implemented per §4.

=== NOT touched (as instructed) ===
Send paths, template routes, /api/numbers/manual, serializeNumber. No FEAT-003 work (no UI, no .env.example, no scratchpad).
